title: Scene 5 · T3 — Beth tilts Susan's chin, takes out the closed stick, uncaps the balm end (SH05)
line: Everything you've been wearing was built for a thirty year old, so it sits on top and sinks into your lines and ages you. This was made for us. Goes on white, don't panic.
motionPlan: Beth tilts Susan's chin to the window with two fingers, takes the closed violet stick from her pocket, her palm over the wordmark, and pulls the cap off the balm end
note: Waits for the Scene 5 ingredient cards' Confirm, then one Seedance call.
